claim_reconciliation_accounting.scope: Validated exact-claim reconciliation receipts only; no mapping is generated and independent gate evidence remains required.

gates.closure_condition: Every artifact has a validated reviewed disposition and independent omission audit
Every page has rendered/version/dependency review; retrieval alone is insufficient
Full-artifact omission review and atomic claims; candidate count is not a claim denominator
All structured occurrences mapped with exact provenance; remaining unstructured claims also reviewed
Every definition and proposal has reviewed scope, policy, parameters and conflicts
Accepted controls have all required tested bindings and accountable review procedures
Approved target inventory, positive/negative behavior tests and recovery receipts
Per-file rights review and approved distribution; inventory notices alone insufficient
Explicit authorized inventory and effective-policy/behavior evidence per target

milestone_accounting.scope: Evidence projection only; owner acceptance, human review, merged-main verification, and release authorization retain their governance requirements.

published_assurance_accounting.scope: Validated authorized assurance attestations only; reviewer judgments are not independently proved by machine validation.

review_accounting.note: Review receipts require independent source-to-control audit before exhaustive certification.

rights_acceptance_accounting.scope: Accountable attestations for the exact specified use/distribution only; not blanket reuse or publication permission.

source_fidelity_accounting.scope: Validated gate-prerequisite attestations only; counts and machine validation do not prove semantic truth or omission-free review.

sources.review_evidence: evidence/source-reviews; source review is not control adoption or independent omission certification
